title: TEMPE ONE: AZ Luxe Escape + Heated Pool & Hot Tub
description:
Desert Luxe Living in the Heart of Tempe

TEMPE ONE is a 4,200 sq ft desert retreat made for gathering. With 6 bedrooms, 5 baths, 2 kitchens, and endless lounge space, it’s perfect for big groups and families.

Enjoy a heated pool, hot tub, fire pits, and rooftop bar with stunning views. Just minutes from the airport, Old Town Scottsdale, and downtown Phoenix, this one-of-a-kind home blends space, style, and comfort for unforgettable stays.

 The space 
Welcome to TEMPE ONE, your ultimate desert escape — a 4,200 sq ft modern oasis designed for gathering, celebrating, and creating memories. Whether you’re here for a family reunion, business trip, bachelor/ette celebration, or just a sun-soaked getaway, this home is made to impress.

Step inside and you’ll find 6 bedrooms, 5 bathrooms, and 2 fully stocked kitchens, with plenty of space to spread out or come together. The open layout flows through stylish social spaces, game areas, and a dining room built for 16.

Outdoors, the fun really begins. Lounge by the pool (heating option is available), soak in the hot tub under the stars, or enjoy drinks and amazing Arizona sunsets on the rooftop patio with sweeping views. Gather around one of the fire pits, play a round of cornhole, or wander through the cactus garden — this home was designed for desert living at its best.

If you need even more space, our sister property, TEMPE TWO, is just two houses down.

We’ve added thoughtful touches to make your stay special:

- Cold waters upon arrival + a stocked coffee/tea bar to settle you in

- Public Goods eco-friendly bath products + fluffy towels for spa-like bathrooms

- Access to a personal concierge for local tips, reservations, and private experiences

Home Details at a Glance:

- 6 Bedrooms: 2 Kings w/ en-suites + 4 Queens

- 5 Bathrooms: 4 full w/ walk-in showers + 2 half baths

- 2 Kitchens + 2 Laundry Rooms

- Indoor games: shuffleboard, foosball, vintage arcade table (200+ classics)

- Outdoor fun: heated pool, hot tub, rooftop bar, fire pits, and yard games

Pool Heating (Heated up to 90 degrees) Fees:

Nov - March 
$70 per day

Apr - Oct
$40 per day

- Parking: garage + driveway + street

Location Highlights:

- 1 mile to ASU + Downtown Tempe

- 4 miles to Sky Harbor Airport + Old Town Scottsdale

- 10 miles to Camelback Mountain + Talking Stick

- Easy access to Spring Training, golf, shopping, and concerts

This home isn’t just a place to stay — it’s a destination all its own. Come ready to relax, celebrate, and experience Arizona in style!

 Guest access 
Enjoy complete privacy and access to the entire home during your stay.

Self check-in is quick + easy with our keyless entry system. Starting at 3 PM, simply use your access code to enter the front door and make yourself at home.

 Other things to note 
THIS IS A NON-SMOKING HOME. Our smoking policy restricts any forms of smoking in the home and on property.

NO PETS ALLOWED. Service animals can be accommodated with proper documentation provided upon booking.

**PLEASE NOTE: A $300 fee will be charged for violation of our smoking or pet policy**

SELF CHECK-IN is available from 3 PM onwards. CHECK-OUT time is promptly at 10 AM.

OTHER POLICIES/ HOUSE RULES:

* NO events or parties allowed whatsoever 

* Must be 25 years old to reserve the home

* Doorbell camera in use on front door only
amenities: Private hot tub - available all year, open 24 hours
Private outdoor pool - available all year, open 24 hours, heated
